rules.description: Provides flags related to battery status.

bit_fields.description: An enabled safety alert is present
An enabled safety fault is present

bit_fields.description: Present security state of the device.
Device is in autonomous FET control mode
Full reset has occurred since last CONFIG_UPDATE exit
SLEEP mode is allowed when other conditions met

rules.name: Alarm Status
rules.description: Latched signal used to assert the ALERT pin. Write a bit high to clear the latched bit.

bit_fields.description: POR bit in Battery Status asserted

rules.name: Alarm Raw Status
rules.description: Unlatched value of flags which can be selected to be latched and used to assert the ALERT pin.

bit_fields.description: POR bit in Battery Status asserted

rules.description: Mask for Alarm Status(). Selects which alarm sources are enabled.

bit_fields.description: POR bit in Battery Status asserted

rules.name: FET CONTROL
rules.description: FET Control: allows host control of individual FET drivers.

rules.name: REGOUT CONTROL
rules.description: REGOUT Control: changes voltage regulator settings.

rules.name: DSG FET Driver PWM Control
rules.description: Controls PWM mode of the DSG FET driver. Values are not used until the second byte is written.

bit_fields.description: DSG FET driver PWM mode enabled

bit_fields.name: DSGPWMON
bit_fields.description: Time DSG FET driver is enabled per cycle. 30.52 us to 3.876 ms in steps of 30.52 us. 0 disables PWM.

bit_fields.name: DSGPWMOFF
bit_fields.description: Time DSG FET driver is disabled per cycle. 122.1 us to 31.128 ms in steps of 122.1 us. 0 disables PWM.

rules.name: CHG FET Driver PWM Control
rules.description: Controls PWM mode of the CHG FET driver. Values are not used until the second byte is written.

bit_fields.description: CHG FET driver PWM mode enabled

bit_fields.name: CHGPWMON
bit_fields.description: Time CHG FET driver is enabled per cycle. 30.52 us to 3.876 ms in steps of 30.52 us. 0 disables PWM.

bit_fields.name: CHGPWMOFF
bit_fields.description: Time CHG FET driver is disabled per cycle. 488.4 us to 124.512 ms in steps of 488.4 us. 0 disables PWM.

rules.name: RESET_PASSQ
rules.description: Resets the accumulated charge and timer.

rules.name: EXIT_DEEPSLEEP
rules.description: Exit DEEPSLEEP mode.

rules.name: DEEPSLEEP
rules.description: Enter DEEPSLEEP mode. Must be sent twice within 4s.

rules.name: SHUTDOWN
rules.description: Start SHUTDOWN sequence. Must be sent twice within 4s.

rules.name: RESET
rules.description: Reset the device.

rules.name: FET_ENABLE
rules.description: Toggle the FET_EN bit in Battery Status().

rules.name: SEAL
rules.description: Place the device in SEALED mode.

rules.name: SET_CFGUPDATE
rules.description: Place the device in CONFIG_UPDATE mode.

rules.name: EXIT_CFGUPDATE
rules.description: Exit CONFIG_UPDATE mode.

rules.name: SLEEP_ENABLE
rules.description: Allow the device to enter SLEEP mode.

rules.name: SLEEP_DISABLE
rules.description: Block the device from entering SLEEP mode.

rules.name: DEVICE_NUMBER
rules.description: Reports the device number (little-endian).

rules.name: FW_VERSION
rules.description: Returns three 16-bit words: Device Number (bytes 0-1, big-endian), Firmware Version (bytes 2-3, big-endian), Build Number (bytes 4-5, big-endian BCD).

fields.name: Device Number
fields.description: Device number in big-endian format (legacy compatibility).

rules.name: HW_VERSION
rules.description: Reports the device hardware version number.

rules.name: PASSQ
rules.description: Accumulated charge and time: PASSQLSB (U4, lower 32 bits), PASSQMSB (I4, upper bits sign-extended), PASSTIME (U4). Full charge is a signed 48-bit value in units of 0.25 userA-s.

fields.name: PASSQMSB
fields.description: Accumulated charge upper bits, sign-extended to 32 bits (little-endian).

fields.name: PASSTIME
fields.description: Accumulated time, 32-bit unsigned, units of 250 ms.

rules.name: CB_ACTIVE_CELLS
rules.description: Cell balancing active cells bit mask.

rules.name: PROT_RECOVERY
rules.description: Allow recovery of selected protection faults.
